title: GeoMerge-OPD: Balanced Skill Integration in Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30632v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models excel at individual robotic skills, yet integrating heterogeneous skills into a single policy remains a key challenge for general-purpose robotic control, especially in whole-body tasks with differing manipulation and locomotion requirements. Common multi-skill integration strategies, such as joint fine-tuning and parameter merging, can induce unintended actions during closed-loop execution, severely degrading individual skills. Task-conditioned analysis of expert updates reveals response energy concentrated in a few dominant directions and opposing expert responses along high-energy directions within a shared, task-relevant response subspace. This structure co-occurs with unintended action shifts after merging. We propose GeoMerge-OPD, combining response-space regularization, parameter merging, and on-policy distillation. During independent expert fine-tuning, G-isometry constrains update-response g

translated_title: GeoMerge-OPD：视觉-语言-动作模型中技能的均衡整合
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在单个机器人技能上表现出色，但将异构技能整合到单一策略中仍是通用机器人控制面临的关键挑战，尤其是在操作与移动需求各异的全身任务中。常见的多技能整合策略，如联合微调和参数合并，可能在闭环执行时引发意外动作，严重损害各单项技能的表现。对专家更新的任务条件化分析表明，响应能量集中于少数主导方向，且在共享的、任务相关的响应子空间内，不同专家的响应沿高能量方向相互对立。这种结构与合并后出现的意外动作偏移同时发生。我们提出GeoMerge-OPD，将响应空间正则化、参数合并与在线策略蒸馏相结合。在独立的专家微调阶段，G-等距性约束更新-响应……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出GeoMerge-OPD方法，通过响应空间正则化（G-等距约束）、参数合并与在线策略蒸馏相结合，实现异构技能在单一VLA模型中的均衡整合，避免闭环执行中的意外动作偏移并保持各专家技能性能。
en_tdlr: GeoMerge-OPD combines response-space regularization (G-isometry constraints), parameter merging, and on-policy distillation to achieve balanced integration of heterogeneous skills into a single VLA model, preventing unintended action shifts while preserving individual expert skill performance.
